policy_scope.reviewed_semantics: Only this original's proposed-not-executed child, false new successor and PREPARATION_ONLY state; no generic caller-configurable exception.
policy_scope.permission_source: Literal original digest in reviewed archive source plus closed structure; recomputed metadata or manifest hashes do not confer permission.
policy_scope.export_fields: Exception denied whenever explicit export_fields exists, including empty or all-field lists. Ordinary limited exports still cannot be called exact original backups.

independent_verification.attack_results: All rejected: 16 mutations each tested through export with spoofed record-hash metadata and inspect with recomputed file hashes, original hash, sizes and archive identity. Variants cover new identity, changed harmless question, nested secret/raw object, extra fields, executed child, successor created, numeric false, active trial, restricted/empty/widened export_fields, caller approval hash, LOCAL_ONLY and synthetic records.

installation_conditions: Integrate only exact frozen delivery bytes; verify the complete approved publishing source hash after integration.
Preserve old originals, archives, public projection, graph behavior and formal evaluator identity.
Coordinator verifies current installation/ownership and records a new maintenance version before normal publisher use.
limits: This reviewer performed only local temporary engineering export/inspect/restore, not the formal catch-up archive or remote upload.
Scientific reproduction, real economics, execution successor, trial start and natural acceptance are not granted.
No production source, installation, original, existing archive, Git or task configuration was modified by the reviewer.
